blocks.text: Yeh chapter ubharti technologies ke zariye computer science ke istemal dekhta hai: voice assistants, chatbots aur tasveer ki pehchan mein artificial intelligence (AI), us ke fawaid aur challenges; Internet of Things (IoT), jahan jure devices khud-kaari ke liye data jama aur share karte hain; AI ke saqafati aur akhlaqi asraat, insaf, shaffafiyat aur stakeholders ke kirdar samet; yeh technologies Pakistan ke qaumi masail kaise hal kar sakti hain, maslan smart zara'at se; aur akhlaqi, paidar istemal ke liye darkar policies, qawaneen aur zimmedarana jiddat.

Ubharti technologies jadeed ijadaat hain jo badal rahi hain ke log kaise rehte, kaam aur rabta karte hain. AI, Internet of Things, cloud computing aur blockchain sanaton ko nayi shakal de rahi aur data, khud-kaari aur rabte ke liye zyada zaheen systems bana rahi hain (Fig 8.1). Yeh sehat, taleem, naql-o-haml aur zara'at mein jiddat lati hain, lekin data ki hifazat, akhlaqiyat aur khud-kaari par inhisar jaise masail bhi uthati hain; inhein samajhna logon ko zimmedari se use karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'smarter systems' chaar dabbon se jura: Artificial Intelligence (data se seekhti; faisla karti), Internet of Things (devices mehsoos aur amal karte), Cloud Computing (online storage aur computing) aur Blockchain (mushtarka, na-qabil-e-tabdeel records). Note: yeh sehat, taleem, naql-o-haml aur zara'at mein use hoti aur hifazat aur akhlaqi sawal bhi uthati hain.
blocks.caption: AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain mil kar (Fig 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chaaron aksar mil jati hain: IoT devices data jama karte, cloud mehfooz karta, AI us se seekhti aur blockchain qabil-e-bharosa record rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain jaisi ubharti technologies agla digital inqilab bana rahi hain, duniya bhar mein logon, data aur devices ko jor rahi hain.
Artificial intelligence (AI)

AI computer science ki woh shaakh hai jo machines ko aise kaam karne deti hai jin ke liye aam taur par insani zehanat chahiye (Fig 8.2). AI systems data parakhte, naqsh pehchante aur kam insani madad se faisle karte hain. Yeh machine learning se seekhte hain: algorithms bare datasets par rujhanat dhoondne ke liye train hote, aur jitna zyada data process karein utne durust hote hain. AI data, algorithms aur computing power ko mila kar awaz samajhti, tasaveer mein cheezein pehchanti aur nataij ka andaza lagati hai, neural networks aur natural language processing (NLP) jaisi techniques se jo dimagh ke maloomat process karne ke tareeqe se mutasir hain.

items: Voice assistants (Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant) boli hui hidayat samajh kar jawab dete hain.
Websites ke chatbots gahakon ke sawal, jaise 'Mera order kahan hai?', hazaron users ke liye aik saath jawab dete hain (Amazon, Daraz).
Tasveer ki pehchan tasaveer aur scans mein chehre, cheezein ya tibbi halat pehchanti hai.
Recommendation systems (YouTube, Daraz, Amazon) user ki pasand se videos ya products tajweez karte hain.
Self-driving gariyan gird-o-pesh samajh kar chalane ke faisle karti hain.

blocks.caption: AI ke fawaid aur challenges
rows: Doctors ki tashkhees mein madad, maslan DeepMind ki AI 3D aankh ke scans se glaucoma jaisi bimariyon ka andaza
Kisanon ki faslon ki nigrani mein madad
Karobar ka gahakon ke rawaiye ka tajzia aur rujhanat ka andaza; zaati parhai aur dhalti tutoring
Logon ki zindagi par asar dalne wale faisle akhlaqi sawal uthate

blocks.text: Jiddat aur zimmedari ka tawazun AI ko aisa tool rakhta hai jo logon ko nuqsan ke bajaye faida de.

blocks.alt: Data, algorithms aur computing power AI model (machine learning) mein jate, jo vision (tasaveer, chehre), awaz aur zaban (NLP), aur faisle aur andaze deta. Neeche sabz fawaid ka dabba: tez takrari kaam, tashkhees mein madad, chatbots, zaati parhai aur faslon ki nigrani; aur surkh challenges ka dabba: raazdari, naukriyon ka khatma, bias aur logon ki zindagi par asar dalne wale faisle.
blocks.caption: AI kaise kaam karti hai, fawaid aur challenges ke saath (Fig 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jo model doctor ki madad karta hai woh janibdar training data par ghair-munsifana faisla bhi kar sakta hai, isi liye fawaid aur challenges saath aate hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Kisan faslon ki nigrani ke liye drones aur sensors ke saath AI use karte hain, jis se paidawar barhti aur zaya kam hota hai.
Internet of Things (IoT)

Internet of Things Internet se jure tabai devices ka network hai jo data jama, share aur us par amal kar sakte hain. Devices mein sensors, processors aur rabte ka hardware hota hai; yeh Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya mobile networks se jurte aur aik doosre ya markazi platform se data ka tabadla karte hain. Is tarah lights, thermostats aur appliances jaisi rozmarra cheezon ki door se nigrani aur control ho sakta hai, aur aise smart mahol bante hain jo kam insani mehnat se chalte hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: IoT fridge, gariyon aur lights jaise rozmarra devices ko jorta hai taake woh khud aik doosre se 'baat' kar sakein.

items: Smart ghar: roshni, heating, parde aur security phone apps ya awaz se control. Smart LED bulb shaam 6:00 baje jal sakte; parde subah ke alarm par khul aur kamra 35 C se garam hone par band ho sakte; thermostat user ki pasand par chalte; cameras phone par alert bhejte. Is se aaram, tawanai ki bachat aur hifazat barhti hai (Fig 8.3).
Sehat: sensors dil ki dharkan, blood pressure aur glucose foran napte hain, taake doctor door se mareezon par nazar rakh kar emergency mein jaldi jawab dein.
Zara'at: devices zameen ki nami, darja hararat aur mausam nap kar aabpashi aur faslon ka intizam karte, paidawar barhate aur zaya kam karte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Smart ghar, fitness bands aur smart khet sab IoT technology se chalte hain.

IoT teen kaamon se chalta hai. Data jama karna: sensors mahol napte hain, jaise darja hararat, harkat ya nami. Rabta: data process aur tajzie ke liye cloud systems ya servers ko bheja jata, aur devices hum-aahang rehte hain. Khud-kaari: tajzia shuda data amal shuru karta hai, jaise khaali kamre ki lights band karna ya zameen khushk hone par aabpashi shuru karna, jis se waqt bachta aur insani ghalti kam hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen teen input sensors (darja hararat, harkat aur roshni) controller, ESP32 jaise microcontroller, ko data dete. Controller Internet ya cloud se data ka tabadla karta, jo mobile app aur daen teen output actuators: smart light, smart fan aur smart socket se jura. Note misali qawaid: shaam 6:00 baje lights, 35 C se oopar parde band, cameras phone par alert.
blocks.caption: IoT se bana smart ghar (Fig 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sensors mehsoos karte, controller aur cloud faisla karte, aur actuators amal karte hain; phone app user ko nazar rakhne aur system badalne deti hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: IoT devices (lights, pankhe, sensors) wale smart ghar ka khaaka banayein, aur label karein ke har device data kaise jama aur bhejta hai.
Cloud computing

Cloud computing users ko data apne computers ke bajaye Internet par door ke servers par mehfooz, munazzam aur process karne deti hai (Fig 8.4). Servers cloud service providers sambhalte hain, is liye data aur applications tak Internet connection se kabhi bhi, kaheen se bhi pohancha ja sakta hai, aur zyada tar processing door hoti hai. Afraad aur karobar hardware sambhale baghair online storage, web hosting aur software use karte hain; streaming, online parhai aur mushtarka kaam ki jagahein sab is par munhasir hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Google Drive ya iCloud par document mehfooz karna cloud computing ka istemal hai.

items: Scalability: storage aur computing power zaroorat ke mutabiq barhai ya ghatai ja sakti hai, jo barhte idaron ke liye munasib hai.
Rasai: kai devices aur jagahon se kaam, files haath se copy kiye baghair.
Kifayat: mehnge servers aur dekh-bhaal ke amle ki zaroorat nahi; jitna use utni adaigi (pay-as-you-go).
Misalein: hosting, storage aur app development ke liye Amazon Web Services (AWS); cloud mein applications banane aur sambhalne ke liye Microsoft Azure.

blocks.alt: Clients (laptop, phone, tablet, desktop) Internet se chaar tahon tak. Service models: SaaS (tayyar software jaise Gmail aur Office 365), PaaS (apps banane ke liye, maslan Google App Engine) aur IaaS (kachi computing jaise virtual machines). Management: billing, nigrani aur scaling, security. Deployment: public, private aur hybrid cloud. Infrastructure: servers aur storage, databases aur networking, data centres.
blocks.caption: Cloud computing tahon mein (Fig 8.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Google Drive SaaS product hai jo log seedha use karte hain; AWS aur Azure aise platforms hain jo karobar aur developers ko teeno service models dete hain.

blocks.text: Blockchain technology

Blockchain digital nizam hai jo maloomat aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par mehfooz aur share karta hai. Har tasdeeq shuda record, yani block, pichhle block se jurta hai, aur aisi zanjeer banti hai jo asani se badli nahi ja sakti; kyunke har computer ke paas nakal hai, pakre baghair data badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai. Yeh ghair-markazi banawat shaffafiyat, hifazat aur bharosa barhati, banks jaise darmiyani idaron ki zaroorat khatam karti aur seedhe, jawabdeh lain-dain mumkin banati hai.

items: Maliyat: mehfooz peer-to-peer lain-dain ke liye Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies.
Supply chains: maal ko asal se gahak tak track kar ke asli hona sabit karna.
Data ki hifazat: qanooni dastavezat, tibbi files aur certificates ki na-qabil-e-tabdeel storage.
Hukoomatein, companies aur schools: zameen ke records, supply chains aur taleemi asnaad.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar blocks. Har aik mein data, apna hash aur pichhle block ka hash (block 1 prev 0000, hash 7a3f; block 2 prev 7a3f; block 3 prev c91e; block 4 prev 05bd). Block 3 surkh, note: ise badalne se is ka hash badalta, is liye block 4 ka prev mel nahi khata. Neeche paanch computers har aik ke paas poori nakal; koi wahid malik nahi, is liye chhupi tabdeeli taqreeban na-mumkin.
blocks.caption: Jure blocks records ko tabdeeli-numa kaise banate hain (blockchain hisse ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hash block ke mawad se nikla mukhtasar fingerprint hai; mawad mein koi bhi tabdeeli bilkul alag fingerprint deti hai. Dikhaye gaye hashes banawati mukhtasar misalein hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Cryptocurrency se supply chain tracking tak, blockchain shaffafiyat se bharosa banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Har zaroorat ko technology se milayein: (a) ghar se mareez ki dil ki dharkan check karna, (b) aise school certificates rakhna jo jaali na ban sakein, (c) barhti company ko foran storage barhane dena, (d) hazaron gahakon ke sawalon ke aik saath jawab.
blocks.explanation: (a) IoT (data bhejne wala pehna jane wala sensor). (b) Blockchain (na-qabil-e-tabdeel records). (c) Cloud computing (scalability). (d) AI (chatbot).

blocks.text: Fauri khulasa

items: AI: insani zehanat wale kaam karti machines; fawaid aur khatre.
IoT: jure devices data jama, rabta aur khud-kaari.
Cloud: door ki storage aur computing; scalable, qabil-e-rasai, pay-as-you-go (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS).
Blockchain: jure, nakal shuda blocks shaffaf, na-qabil-e-tabdeel records dete.
